summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys found out that each morning new trash are appearing at the site where there used to be a garbage bin. Meanwhile, there is an arguement between Beika shopping center store association members about whether they should use store association budget to reinstall new garbage bin. At the same moment, Ran's teacher asked the class to submit ideas for entertaining the guests coming to Tokyo for WSG. Mysterious Appearances Location: Beika Shopping Center Appearing objects: Trash Suspects: Beika shopping center store association members, crows After cleaning all day the streets of the shopping center, the Detective Boys notice that each morning, new trash appears at the site where there used to be a garbage bin. They have to stop the serial litterer.
